FFmpeg 7.1.2 (LGPL 2.1+ only: no --enable-gpl, no --enable-nonfree)
Source:  https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.2.tar.xz
SHA-256: 089bc60fb59d6aecc5d994ff530fd0dcb3ee39aa55867849a2bbc4e555f9c304

Only libavcodec/libavutil sources and headers that the flv, vp6f and vp6a decoders
actually compile are kept (FFmpeg's directory layout). Per-ABI generated files
(config.h, config_components.h, codec_list.c, ... and sources.cmake) are in config/<abi>/.

Common configure flags: --disable-everything --disable-asm --disable-programs --disable-doc --disable-network --disable-avdevice --disable-avformat --disable-avfilter --disable-swresample --disable-swscale --disable-postproc --disable-autodetect --disable-jni --disable-mediacodec --disable-hwaccels --disable-debug --disable-stripping --enable-decoder=flv,vp6f,vp6a --enable-pic --enable-small --enable-cross-compile --target-os=android 
Per ABI: --arch/--cpu/--cc/--ar/--ranlib/--nm/--strip/--sysroot of NDK 27.1.12297006, API 30, --extra-cflags=-MMD.

Regenerate with scripts/ffmpeg/vendor-ffmpeg.sh
